Release notes/v0.8.0/Oct 30, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.8.0.

Cadence Pro is here. Cadence stays free while you're watching: dictation, as many agents as you like, the Inbox and Talk, and Cadence learning your judgment and suggesting what to do. Pro is for when you're not watching: Cadence answering for you, away mode, long runs, its own long-job ideas and the iPhone app.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 New

  • Cadence Pro. $20 a month, $200 a year, or $249 once for one of the first 100 founding seats, which keep Pro for good. See cadencevoice.ai/pricing.
    • Buy from the app. Settings → Pro has the plans. Checkout opens in your browser, and Pro turns itself on when you've paid. No account needed.
    • Or paste a key. Every purchase comes with a license key, shown after checkout and on your receipt. Paste it into Settings → Pro on any of your Macs.
    • Manage your plan from Settings → Pro: change your card, switch between monthly and yearly, see invoices or cancel.
  • What Pro covers:
    • Cadence answering for you, with a countdown or quietly, once you've handed it a kind of question.
    • Away mode.
    • Long runs, and long jobs Cadence thinks up toward your goals.
    • The iPhone app, near your Mac or away from home.

Get Cadence

Free for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later. The download is always the newest version.
